Glen / team — quick technical clarification from compliance side:

- Our common deployment pattern for Acme-size workloads would use regional EU clusters (Frankfurt/Amsterdam) with optional edge caches in the UK for lower RTT. Those caches are configured as ephemeral KV caches (TTL-based) and do not persist audit logs or content beyond operational telemetry.
- Because they are ephemeral caches (no long-term storage of user prompts/responses), they do not change the TIA mapping in most cases. We will, however, include the cache hosts in the processing map and declare them as transient subprocessors.
- If your security team requires onshore logging for residency reasons (e.g., store request logs on UK-hosted buckets), that would be a separate change and would require a scoped TIA / DTIA addendum.

I'll attach a short note (for procurement) summarizing: "Cache: UK edge, ephemeral (TTL < 24h), no persistent logs; processing map includes transient cache nodes; SCCs + UK Addendum required." Laura — can you add subprocessor list and retention notes?

We can bundle everything into a single DocuSign envelope if Acme confirms the signatory and timeline. If you need the UK addendum redlined, we can route to legal but the standard form usually suffices.
